rules.title: FAIR Act: ban on rental property owners using algorithmic rent-setting coordinators
rules.requirement: Rental property owners and their agents may not pay for, subscribe to, contract for, or otherwise exchange consideration for the services of a coordinator (algorithmic revenue management software or device performing a coordinating function). Violations are violations of the New Jersey Antitrust Act.
rules.key_value: Prohibited: paying for or using the services of an algorithmic rent-setting coordinator
rules.coverage_conditions: All rental property owners (any person owning directly or indirectly one or more rental residential dwelling units) and their agents, representatives, or subcontractors, for residential dwelling units used as a primary residence in New Jersey.
rules.exemptions: Excludes government entities setting rents through affordability controls; research/statistical analysis not used to set prices or terms; free public rent estimates; real estate brokerage databases available on equal terms that do not set or recommend prices; spreadsheets without AI requiring human analysis; databases only querying unprocessed data. Excludes inpatient medical care, licensed long-term care, and detention or correctional facilities.
rules.penalty: Violation of the New Jersey Antitrust Act, P.L.1970, c.73 (C.56:9-1 et seq.); remedies of C.56:9-6 through 9-17 apply. Attorney General complaint portal.
rules.conflict_note: Effective date computed from 'first day of the twelfth month next following the date of enactment' with approval July 20, 2026, yielding 2027-07-01. Section 6(b) prohibits municipalities from enacting ordinances that conflict with this act, which may affect existing local algorithmic rent-setting ordinances (e.g., Hoboken, Jersey City). N.J.S.A. section number inferred from codification range 56:9-20 to 56:9-26.

rules.title: FAIR Act: ban on coordinators performing coordinating functions and on parallel pricing coordination
rules.requirement: No coordinator may facilitate agreements among rental property owners that restrict competition, and no person may perform a coordinating function or engage in or facilitate parallel pricing coordination using algorithms and competitively sensitive information to set or recommend rents, lease terms, or occupancy levels.
rules.key_value: Prohibited: coordinating function / parallel pricing coordination
rules.coverage_conditions: Any person, coordinator, or agent/subcontractor of a coordinator, including a rental property owner performing a coordinating function for its own benefit, regarding residential dwelling units in New Jersey.
rules.exemptions: Government entities setting or limiting rents through affordability controls; research or statistical analysis not used in setting prices or terms; free public rent estimates; brokerage databases on equal terms that do not set or recommend prices or collect competitively sensitive information for that purpose.
rules.penalty: Violation of the New Jersey Antitrust Act, P.L.1970, c.73 (C.56:9-1 et seq.); remedies of C.56:9-6 through 9-17 apply.
